experiment_data.hypothesis: The convergent entry-exit routing architecture (inverted-U R² profile, L1 instruction-dominance with consistent mixed heads h13/h22, counterfactual sensitivity) observed in TraceVLA on Spatial/Object generalizes to LIBERO-Long (multi-step tasks). Tests cross-suite consistency for second architecture family. Both trained and untrained conditions.

spec.command: bash -c "source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base && cd /root/autodl-tmp/vla-ssd && python scripts/tracvla_long_full_pipeline.py --conditions trained untrained"
